caption:
Good speech: say what is good or keep silent.

The Prophet ﷺ linked faith in Allah and the Last Day to three things: not harming your neighbor, honoring your guest, and speaking good or staying silent. As the day ends, look back at the words you used today.

Sahih al-Bukhari 6136 · Grade: Sahih

Which of the three will you work on this week?

#goodspeech #neighbors #muslimmanners #hadithoftheday
alt_text: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, should not hurt his neighbor and whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, should serve his guest generously and whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, should speak what is good or keep silent (Sahih al-Bukhari 6136)
